name: Tracking Event Support
description: Declares Phase 9 visitor/marketing tracking events implemented by the Site UI.
purpose: Keeps visitor measurement observations distinct from authoritative Phase 13 domain Events.

fields.description: Canonical NEXT F Marketing tracking event IDs supported by the Site.

validationRules.description: Every tracking event must resolve to registry/marketing/tracking-events.json.
Tracking support must never be interpreted as authoritative domain-event production.
Optional analytics/marketing dispatch remains governed by consent and destination data policy.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
